text.description_html:
Acorn AILBP, 17-1/4" Bean Tip Iron Dummy Strap Hinge

The 17-1/4" Smooth Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Hinges is for use with butt hinges. It is made out of heavy gauge steel with a black finish. Decorative straps give an old world charm to any home door, gate, shutter, or garage door without the need of installing working hinges or replacing existing hardware. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Also Available Matching: 12 Inch Bean Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge and 21-1/4 Inch Bean Tip Smooth Iron Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the Bean Tip 17-1/4" Dummy Strap Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 17-1/4"
  • Width: 1-9/16"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
